description: BC Drought Levels is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoBC Branch. The BC Drought Levels layer represents the current drought levels in the Province of British Columbia. The levels are updated as required during the core drought season by GeoBC and the Water Management Branch of the Ministry of Forests. Core drought season typically begins following spring freshet and ends with the onset of winter conditions. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher GeoBC Branch. Its tags are AGO, AGOL, ArcGIS Online, BC, British Columbia. It offers 2 resource(s) in ARCGIS_REST, FGDB. The portal shows 2025-05-14 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
